name: Juniper Hallway & Entry
description: Hallway specialist. Value shop: solid everyday pieces at sensible prices. We carry shoe racks, mirrors, cabinets.
skill_description: We sell shoe racks, mirrors, cabinets, and nothing else. Describe the piece you need in your own words (use, size, material, capacity) and we offer a matching item from our range with a price. Then send your offer as a number; we answer with a counteroffer or close the sale with a receipt.
